title: WBJEE result 2025 postponed, was scheduled for today - Hindustan Times
text:
WBJEE result 2025 postponed, was scheduled for today
WBJEE result 2025, which was scheduled for today, has been postponed.
The West Bengal Joint Entrance Examination Board (WBJEEB) has postponed the WBJEE result 2025 announcement.
Earlier, the WBJEE board chairperson Sonali Chakraborty Banerjee said that results will be declared on August 7.
The results have already been delayed by over a month due to legal proceedings, but the road was cleared last month following a Supreme Court order staying the Calcutta High Court decision to halt the implementation of a revised list of OBCs notified by the state government.
WBJEE board chairperson Sonali Chakraborty Banerjee said that results will be declared on August 7, news agency PTI reported.
"From today (July 31), candidates will have to upload details about their caste category certificate in the relevant section of WBJEE portal till August 2. The board will sort out the data and incorporate updates of every candidate before coming up with the results," she told PTI.
"We are sure the process (of uploading details) will be over by the stipulated time and the results will be published on August 7," the WBJEEB chairperson added.
However, with this recent confirmation, the result declaration has been further delayed. A confirmation regarding the new result date is awaited.
The state-level entrance test was conducted on April 27 in two shifts- from 11 am to 1 pm, and from 2 pm to 4 pm.
After the exam, the board released the provisional answer key and invited objections on the payment of a non-refundable fee.
Candidates who appeared for the exam are advised to visit the official website, wbjeeb.nic.in for result-related updates.
